remarks:
DIRECT ENTRY

(i)     ILORIN â€“ For Educational Technology/Introductory Technology requires;

a)       NCE with not less than Merit in any of Arabic, Christian Religious Studies, English Language, Fine and Applied Arts, French, History, Islamic Studies, Nigerian Languages.  Any three (3) relevant subjects in IJMB and JUPEB.

b)       NCE with not less than Merit in any of Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Health Education, Human Kinetics, Integrated Science, Mathematics, Physics, Technology Education, and National Diploma (ND) with not less than Lower Credit in A-V Technology; Electrical/ Mechanical/ Civil Engineering/ Woodwork/ Metallurgical, Computer Science, Mass Communication and Computer Science.  Any three relevant subjects in IJMB and JUPEB.

c)       NCE with not less than Merit in any of Accounting, Economics, Geography, Political Science, Social Studies.  Any three relevant subjects in IJMB and JUPEB.

Minor subject can be from any of the subjects outlined under Direct Entry requirement.  Unilorin Diploma in Instructional Radio & Television Production and Diploma in Photography is acceptable for Direct Entry Admission.

For Technology Education, ILORIN accepts;

a)       NCE (Technical) with not less than Merit or National Diploma (ND) or Advanced National Technical Certificate (ANTC) with not less than Lower Credit in all fields of Engineering and Technology.

b)       NCE with not less than Merit in subject combinations of Physics, Computer, Integrated Science, Chemistry and Biology.

c)       IJMB or JUPEB with Physics, or Chemistry or Biology as one of the subjects passed.

d)       Any three (3) relevant subjects in IJMB and JUPEB.

(ii)   YABA-DEG accepts Two (2) A Level passes in Physics and Mathematics.
ND lower credit in Civil Engineering, Production/Electrical Engineering, Drafting Technology
Final City and Guilds or its equivalent plus National Technical Certificate.
NCE credit in Technical Education plus O Level credit passes in Physics or Mathematics. Engineering Technicians Part II Certificate Candidates with UNN Diploma at Distinction/Credit/Merit in the Following: Computer Education, Physics/Mathematics and Computer Science.

(iii)  KADPOLY requires NCE Technical merit in relevant programme or C grade in all major subjects and accepts into a two(2)-year programme candidates from institutions affiliated to ABU.

(iv)  KADPOLY and EBSU accept ND lower credit in relevant programme.

(v)   KADPOLY accepts full Technological Certificate in related technical subjects and Technical Teachers Certificate (TTC).

(vi)  MINNA accepts City and Guilds Final with Technical Teachers Certificate(TTC), Advanced National Technical Certificate and ND in relevant programme in addition to the 'O' Level certificate.

vii)  ESUTECH accepts Technical Drawing and ND/          NCE (merit) in specialized areas.

(viii)   UNN accepts

a.        two (2)'A' Level passes in Physics and Mathematics in addition to departmental UTME requirements.

b.       ND lower credit in Civil                Engineering, Production/Elect. Engineering, Drafting Technology.

c.        Final City and Guilds or its equivalent plus National Technical Certificate.

d.       NCE merit pass in Technical Education

e.       Engineering Technicians Part II Certificate.

(ix)  NDU â€“ Same as Vocational and Technical Education.

(x)   UMUDIKE accepts two (2)'A' Level passes in relevant subjects, NCE, ND, or NBC/NDC.

(xi)  TASUED requires two (2) 'A' Level passes/HSC, NCE (merit) in relevant teaching subjects or ND/HND (upper credit).

 (xii) BSU requires;

a)       ND/HND with Upper Credit pass in a specialized area OF Industrial or Engineering Technology.

b)       Candidates should also satisfy University â€˜Oâ€™ Level requirements.

c)       NCE with 9 points and above with a pass in English language in General studies & HND holders undergo the programme for three years. NCE use of English is acceptable in lieu of â€˜Oâ€™ level in English Language.

d)       â€˜Aâ€™ level pass in any of the acceptable subjects.

e)       Preliminary degree candidates (from Benue State University only). Must pass at least five (5) out of the six (6) subjects studies with pass level of at least 50% in each subject.

 

 

 

UTME

(i)      ILORIN â€“ For Educational Technology/Introductory Technology requires  Credits in English and Mathematics, in the minor subject, and any other three O/Level subjects selected from Arts and Social Science Subjects, OR  Credits in English and Mathematics, in the minor subject, and any other three O/Level subjects selected from Science or Technical Subjects, OR  Credits in English and Mathematics, and any other three O/Level selected from Social Sciences subjects.

For Technology Education, ILORIN accepts SSCE/WAEC/NECO/NABTEB with five credits passes in English Language and Mathematics plus three other related subjects (Physics, Chemistry, Computer Studies, Technical Drawing, Electronics, Auto-Mechanics, Basic Electricity, Metalwork, Woodwork, Building Construction, etc.).

(ii)   MAUTY requires Mathematics, Chemistry and Biology.

(iii)  KADPOLY requires 'O' Level credit passes in Mathematics and other subjects in English Language, Technical Drawing, Fine Arts, TC II and Pre-NCE (T).

(iv)  KADPOLY accepts 'O' Level and Federal Craft Certificate, National Technical Certificate (NTC) with Mathematics and other relevant subjects.

(v)   UNN requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes to include Physics or Mathematics at GCE/SSC, NTC, City and Guilds intermediate in addition to the UTME entry requirements.

(vi)  ESUTECH requires 'O' Level credit pass in English Language.

(vii) NDU accepts NTC/NBC and 'O' Level pass in English but requires 'O' Level credit pass in Physics.

(viii)YABA-DEG requires  Five (5) O Level credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics and any other three (3) subjects from: Physics, Chemistry, Further Mathematics, Biology/Agricultural Science, Geography, Economics, Applied Electricity, Auto Body Repairs Spray Painting, Auto Electricity Work, Auto Mechanical Work/Mechanics, Metal Work, Machine Wood Work, Technical Drawing, Furniture Making/Upholstery, Welding & Fabrication/Engineering Craft Practice, Building Construction and Electrical Installation & Maintenance Work..

(ix)  MINNA requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Physics and any other two (2)relevant science and/or Technical subjects.

(x)   EDOMOK requires five (5)'O' Level credit passes to include Mathematics and Physics.

(xi)  UMUDIKE requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry.

(xii)  TASUED requires five (5)'O' Level credit passes at one (1) sitting or six (6)'O' Level credit passes at two (2) sittings to include English Language, Mathematics and other subjects from Arts, Social Sciences or Sciences.

(xiii)BSU - Candidates must possess a minimum of five Credits at not more than two (2) sittings at SSC (or its equivalent) or federal craft certificate. This includes credit in English Language, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and any one of Social Sciences or Technical Drawing and a Technological subject area such as Woodwork, Metalwork, Electronics, Electronics, Electrical Installation, etc.

 

UTME SUBJECTS

(i)       ESUTECH requires Economics.

(ii)     UMUDIKE and NDU require Chemistry as the third subject.

(iii)    CALABAR accepts any three (3) relevant subjects.

(iv)    TASUED requires subject of specialization and one (1) each from the Arts and Social Sciences or Sciences.

(v)     MINNA requires Mathematics, Physics and any of Biology, Agricultural Science, Chemistry, Economics, Geography or Arts.

(vi)    BSU requires Mathematics, Physics and any one of Chemistry, Biology, Economics or Geography.

(vii)  ILORIN - For Educational Technology/Introductory Technology requires  English Language, minor subject, and ANY other two subjects selected from Arts and Social Science, Subjects, OR  English Language, minor subject, and ANY other two subjects selected from Science and Technical, Subjects, OR  English Language and any other three Social Sciences subjects.

For Technology Education, ILORIN requires Mathematics and any other two of Physics, Chemistry, Computer Studies, Technical Drawing, Electrical/Electronic Auto-Mechanics, Applied Electricity, Metalwork, and Woodwork.

(viii) YABA-DEG requires  English Language, Mathematics and any other two (2) subjects from:  Physics, Chemistry, Further Mathematics, Biology/Agricultural Science, Geography, Economics, Applied Electricity, Auto Body Repairs Spray Painting, Auto Electricity Work, Auto Mechanical Work/Mechanics, Metal Work, Machine Wood Work, Technical Drawing, Furniture Making/Upholstery, Welding & Fabrication/Engineering Craft Practice, Building Construction and Electrical Installation & Maintenance Work
